title: Mother & Girl at Picnic Table, 1950s B&W Deckle Edge Snapshot Photo
description: A candid mid-century snapshot featuring a smiling woman in eyeglasses and a patterned dress sitting at an outdoor wooden picnic table next to a young girl in a sunsuit. The setting appears to be a sunny park with palm foliage overhead, capturing a relaxed moment of family outdoor leisure during the post-WWII era.
